description: Facebook Ad Library Search: search the public Meta Ad Library by keyword for ads on Facebook and Instagram. Per ad the page name, ad text, active status, start and end dates, publisher platforms, call to action, landing link and media links in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Competitor ad research. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
